title: Repair a Price Conversion
summary: Correct a conversion when numeric text contains a currency symbol.

contract.input: Price text beginning with `$`, followed by a valid non-negative decimal value.

examples.explanation: Only the leading currency symbol is excluded from conversion.

constraints: price_text begins with exactly one $ symbol
commonMistakes: Removing a fixed number of decimal digits

blocks.content: The supplied price text begins with a currency symbol. The current conversion fails. Remove the leading symbol before converting the remaining value to a decimal number.

blocks.title: parse_price(price_text)
blocks.content:
Input: Price text beginning with `$`, followed by a valid non-negative decimal value.

Output: The numeric price.

blocks.caption: Only the leading currency symbol is excluded from conversion.

blocks.title: Constraints
blocks.content:
price_text begins with exactly one $ symbol
The remaining text represents 0 to 1000000
